question_evidence_quote: If, for the remaining of the days of the week, an equal number of vehicles passed through the toll booth
observed_error: The response subtracts only Wednesday and Thursday when counting the remaining days.
violated_condition: The remaining days exclude all four specified days, Monday through Thursday, so their count is 7 - 4.
error_description: The response counts the remaining days by subtracting only the two days with 100 cars from seven. Monday and Tuesday were also already included in the 300-car subtotal, so the remaining 150 cars belong to three days. The subtraction is executed correctly, but its day-count relation is wrong.
